title: Penne with fresh tomato and spinach sauce
summary: Garlic-free penne with chopped fresh tomatoes and wilted spinach.
aliases: penne pasta with tomato and spinach sauce
pasta with tomato and spinach sauce
penne with tomato and spinach sauce
source: Pranav's requested recipe, 2026-11-08. Pasta, sauce and spinach timers from cook-times.json; not yet kitchen-tested.
notes: Chop the fresh tomatoes first. There is no garlic. The pasta packet time wins over the table's 11-minute penne default. Remy should give one step at a time and keep knife guidance plain if a hazard appears.
ingredients: About 2 litres water and 20g salt for the pasta
Salt and black pepper for the sauce
Optional: chilli flakes and grated Parmesan

steps.instruction: Chop the tomatoes into small pieces first. Keep your fingertips tucked and clear of the blade.
looks_right: tomatoes cut into small pieces on a stable board
guiding fingertips tucked away from the cutting edge
looks_wrong: whole tomatoes still on the board
fingertips visibly ahead of or under the cutting edge (safety alert first)
steps.done_when: All four tomatoes are chopped into small pieces and the knife is set down.

steps.instruction: Bring about 2 litres of water to a rolling boil in a large pot, then add the pasta salt.
looks_right: large bubbles breaking across the water surface
looks_wrong: water only simmering with small bubbles
pot too small for the penne to move freely
steps.done_when: The water is at a rolling boil and salted.

steps.instruction: Add the penne and stir so it does not stick. Start its timer when the water returns to the boil; use the packet time if it differs.
looks_right: penne moving freely in boiling water
looks_wrong: foam rising to the rim (turn the heat down a little)
steps.done_when: The penne is in the boiling water, stirred, and its timer is running.

steps.instruction: Warm the olive oil in a pan, add the chopped tomatoes and simmer gently. Stir and season with salt, pepper and optional chilli.
looks_right: tomatoes breaking down into a thick, gently bubbling sauce
looks_wrong: tomatoes still watery at the timer check (keep simmering and check texture)
steps.done_when: The tomatoes have broken down and the sauce is thick enough to coat the penne; taste and adjust seasoning.

steps.instruction: Stir the spinach into the tomato sauce until wilted.
looks_right: spinach leaves collapsed into the sauce
looks_wrong: spinach still piled on top and unwilted
steps.done_when: The spinach is wilted through the sauce.

steps.instruction: At the penne timer check, taste a piece. When it has a little bite but no chalky centre, save a mug of pasta water and drain it.
looks_right: a bitten piece has no chalky white centre
looks_wrong: chalky centre (cook longer and taste again)
steps.done_when: The cook confirms the bite is right; the penne is drained and a mug of pasta water is saved.

steps.instruction: Toss the penne through the tomato and spinach sauce. Add a splash of saved pasta water if needed, then serve with optional Parmesan.
looks_right: sauce clinging to the penne without pooling at the bottom
looks_wrong: dry penne (add a little saved pasta water)
watery sauce pooling under the pasta (toss and reduce briefly)
steps.done_when: The penne is evenly coated and served.
